name.full: Elsa Elisabeth Nilsdotter Svinhuvud Stierna Kopparbergsätten

notes: COMPOUND NAME BAKES IN A SUPERSEDED GENEALOGICAL ERROR (deep-chain audit, 2026-07-03): the name field ' Elsa Elisabeth Nilsdotter Svinhuvud Stierna Kopparbergsätten' should read Elsa Nilsdotter — her patronymic 'Nilsdotter' is correct (father Nils Hansson of the Stjärna/Kopparberg family), but 'Svinhufvud' belongs to her mother Gertrud Knutsdotter's (I182620320732) line, not her own inherited surname/arms. The fused name repeats a documented 19th/20th-century antiquarian mistake that modern Swedish genealogical scholarship has since corrected. — Mina Släktanor: Släkten Svinhufvud (af Qvalstad) i Dalarna; Geni & FamilySearch entries for Elsa Nilsdotter reflect the corrected parentage.
